scope_statement: Escaped Draw rendering, detected-trace visibility, and Image export diagnosis defects in Insertion Loss Tool.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Generate in Draw leaves only the drawing editor visible instead of the complete S-parameter plots.
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The Draw success callback rendered data but did not switch from the editor to the generated plot workspace.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Two detected traces sampled as Magenta use identical swatches and overlays.
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: Display styling reused the sampled source-pixel color rather than a stable per-trace palette.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Unassigned S12, S21, and S22 mappings appear as Default and generation fails with a generic message.
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The UI mislabeled the internal unassigned token and discarded the backend's actionable error.
